push_subscription_web_keys.name: push_subscription_web_keys
push_subscription_web_keys.value: "push_subscription"."platform" <> 'web' or ("push_subscription"."p256dh" is not null and "push_subscription"."auth" is not null)

listing_at_lister_has_area.name: listing_at_lister_has_area
listing_at_lister_has_area.value: not ('at_lister' = any("listing"."handovers")) or "listing"."area" is not null

listing_elsewhere_has_place.name: listing_elsewhere_has_place
listing_elsewhere_has_place.value: not ('elsewhere' = any("listing"."handovers")) or "listing"."meeting_place" is not null

listing_positive_numbers.name: listing_positive_numbers
listing_positive_numbers.value:
("listing"."amount" is null or "listing"."amount" > 0) and ("listing"."remaining" is null or "listing"."remaining" >= 0)
      and ("listing"."loan_length" is null or "listing"."loan_length" > 0)
      and ("listing"."session_length" is null or "listing"."session_length" > 0)
      and ("listing"."sessions_available" is null or "listing"."sessions_available" >= 1)
      and ("listing"."sessions_remaining" is null or "listing"."sessions_remaining" >= 0)

listing_units_with_numbers.name: listing_units_with_numbers
listing_units_with_numbers.value:
("listing"."amount" is null) = ("listing"."unit" is null)
      and ("listing"."loan_length" is null) = ("listing"."loan_length_unit" is null)
      and ("listing"."session_length" is null) = ("listing"."session_length_unit" is null)

listing_fields_match_type.name: listing_fields_match_type
listing_fields_match_type.value:
("listing"."type" = 'lend' or ("listing"."loan_length" is null))
      and ("listing"."type" = 'service' or ("listing"."session_length" is null and "listing"."sessions_available" is null and "listing"."sessions_remaining" is null))
      and ("listing"."type" <> 'service' or ("listing"."amount" is null))
      and ("listing"."type" in ('gift', 'trade') or "listing"."remaining" is null)

trade_accept_amount.name: trade_accept_amount
trade_accept_amount.value: ("trade_accept"."amount" is null or "trade_accept"."amount" > 0) and ("trade_accept"."amount" is null) = ("trade_accept"."unit" is null)

proposal_positive_numbers.name: proposal_positive_numbers
proposal_positive_numbers.value:
("proposal"."loan_length" is null or "proposal"."loan_length" > 0) and ("proposal"."amount" is null or "proposal"."amount" > 0)
      and ("proposal"."own_offer_amount" is null or "proposal"."own_offer_amount" > 0)
      and ("proposal"."session_length" is null or "proposal"."session_length" > 0) and ("proposal"."sessions" is null or "proposal"."sessions" >= 1)

proposal_units_with_numbers.name: proposal_units_with_numbers
proposal_units_with_numbers.value:
("proposal"."loan_length" is null) = ("proposal"."loan_length_unit" is null)
      and ("proposal"."session_length" is null) = ("proposal"."session_length_unit" is null)
      and ("proposal"."own_offer_amount" is null) = ("proposal"."own_offer_unit" is null)

proposal_text_lengths.name: proposal_text_lengths
proposal_text_lengths.value:
("proposal"."own_offer" is null or char_length("proposal"."own_offer") <= 300)
      and ("proposal"."decision_note" is null or char_length("proposal"."decision_note") <= 500)

generated.as: case when "loan_starts_at" is null then null else tstzrange("loan_starts_at", "loan_ends_at") end

agreement_loan_has_period.name: agreement_loan_has_period
agreement_loan_has_period.value: ("agreement"."outcome" = 'lent') = ("agreement"."loan_starts_at" is not null and "agreement"."loan_ends_at" is not null and "agreement"."loan_starts_at" < "agreement"."loan_ends_at")
